home.subtitle: A five-minute practice for more peaceful thinking
home.howto.title: How the practice works
home.howto.p1: Each step starts with 5 seconds to read the instruction and get ready. Then the one-minute exercise begins.
home.howto.p2: Use this minute to focus, think, remember or imagine. You do not need to find the right answer.
home.howto.p3: In the last step, make one small decision. Imagine what you will do, or not do, when the moment comes.
practice.step1.title: Stop
practice.step1.guide: Choose something easy to focus on: your breathing, an object, a sound, or a feeling in your body. Focus on it for one minute. If you get distracted, gently come back to it.
practice.step2.title: See a living being
practice.step2.guide: Start with yourself. Like you, every living being wants to live and does not want to suffer. Stay with this thought for one minute.
practice.step3.title: Wish someone well
practice.step3.guide: Think of someone you can easily wish well. For one minute, keep coming back to a simple kind wish for them.
practice.step4.title: Reduce harm
practice.step4.guide: For one minute, think about how you could reduce harm to yourself or others.
practice.step5.title: Make a choice
practice.step5.guide: Make one small decision: something to do, or not to do, soon. Then picture the right moment and imagine how you will act.
done.title: Now act on it.

feedback.audio.label: Voice recording
feedback.optin.note: If you select this option, we will ask for your email only for short questions and invitations to test 5. This is not a newsletter.
feedback.privacy.short: When you send feedback, we save the text or voice recording, language, app version, the version of the text you saw, the number of the practice you just completed on this device, and technical data about the submission. We use this only to improve 5. We save your email only if you agree to help with testing. Voice recordings are stored privately.
